phase: 16 storage-correction — file-size-only vs du -sb persistent-byte accounting
change_scope: NEW files only. No existing court, aggregator, manifest or real100-v1 file was modified. The corrected accounting is a new court; the original phase15-*/phase16-* courts and real100-court.sh are untouched.
accounting_old: du -sb DIR (GNU --apparent-size: sums regular-file st_size AND each directory inode's st_size)
accounting_new: find DIR -type f -printf '%s\n' | awk sum (regular-file st_size only; directories contribute 0)
filesystem: ext4 bind mount; every directory inode reports st_size = 4096 B

distortion_measured.unit: bytes; over the 96 successful store trees of this run
